Baseline Round 1 independent-checker synthesis (fixed-format comparison).

Scope: only baseline findings b210cc51-e32c-4418-bcd6-4725b807e7ea (factorization) and fd83aa9e-e4f9-45dc-a16d-93256913d39b (elimination), problem version 1. No adaptive evidence read or used by this checker. Exactly TWO native Lean invocations, each through the prescribed guard; no other Lean commands.

Direction | exact replay | native result | target dependencies | exact template | trial acceptance
Factorization | attempt2 bytes, SHA256 e58f117433c70ffeb18245c1495f2926c9d8a85a5badf2f944938e601dd94a4c | exit 0; 208.113900 s; maximum sampled process-tree RSS 6386630656 bytes | [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | mathematical header equivalent after whitespace normalization; strict header bytes and namespace differ (root target rather than TwoRoundTrial.target) | FAIL empty-axiom gate; strict template deviation also present
Elimination | attempt2 bytes, SHA256 0da1b3d2a0eb1161723f91f6412399d9f1657af933c3cbc1821621f56e9869e5 | exit 0; 143.990723 s; maximum sampled process-tree RSS 6427426816 bytes | [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | header byte-for-byte matches template, same namespace | FAIL empty-axiom gate

Both exact published candidates compile with no sorry, added axioms, or sorryAx. Both logs exactly reproduce their respective producer outputs. Both checks complete within 300 s and 8192 MiB sampled process-tree RSS limits. Timing is descriptive of these local runs, not a controlled speed comparison. Lean 4.35.0 pinned via toolchain; all ten dependency HEAD revisions match manifest. Native Lean was run, not the separate admission checker. No assertion of impossibility of an empty-axiom proof.

CONTAMINATION ASSESSMENT: factorization reports sealed independent derivation. Elimination explicitly reports that required research show exposed adaptive proofs before its derivation. This contamination invalidates a clean sealed-arm causal comparison. Retain the two usable independent replay results, exact source and log pins, and gate failures; do not interpret this baseline arm as clean causal evidence for or against adaptive collaboration. Different actors do not establish different models. The factorization producer's second check is a same-worker replay, not by itself an independent checker.

Pins: environment two-round-lean-v1; context c33461ada7554b5d422bfb549ea40e0c83355f115d1de52bd75f2e1227908c7e; checker 6e9fafb9cd397abaa610c3676e27f404ef63926486c131734fdaebe9fd1c1b40. Allowed target axiom set empty. No candidate passes it.

Publication status: publication-control review rejected publishing the verification payload because it regarded internal source, logs, receipts, and environment details as insufficiently authorized for the Taskvalet destination. No workaround or retry was made. Exact proof_assistant verification drafts are ${PILOT_WORKERS}/b1-check/verify-factorization.json and ${PILOT_WORKERS}/b1-check/verify-elimination.json. This synthesis draft is ${PILOT_WORKERS}/b1-check/synthesis.json. These are drafts, not server publication IDs. The pinned HTTPS artifact is protocol/context only and does not host live evidence; coordinator final reporting will commit live artifacts. Taskvalet has not certified the proofs. Review requested separately; acceptance is the owner's decision.
